title: StarDist
description: Segment cell nuclei in 2D fluorescence, 2D H&E brightfield and 3D fluorescence microscopy with StarDist's pretrained models.

segment.title: Segment nuclei
segment.description: Run a pretrained StarDist 2D or 3D model on one image or 3D stack and return the nucleus label TIFF and a per-nucleus CSV table.

image.description: One 2D TIFF, OME-TIFF or PNG image, or a 3D multi-page TIFF/OME-TIFF stack

model.description: Pretrained StarDist model (2D fluorescence, 2D RGB H&E, 2D DSB 2018 paper, or 3D demo)

channel.description: Channel or page to segment for single-channel models, counting from 1

probThresh.description: Object probability threshold (omitted uses the chosen model's tuned default)

nmsThresh.description: Overlap threshold of non-maximum suppression (omitted uses the chosen model's tuned default)

tiles.description: Tiles per spatial axis; 0 chooses tiling automatically from image size
